properties.name: Marshall's Court
properties.note: Edinburgh Council name is Marshall's Court
Formerly a foot and adjiacent cycle crossing. As of July 2023 this is a foot only crossing.
Markings on the road denote "no entry" in one direction as of January 2024. Council has confirmed this is erroneous and the section is due to be re-lined.
